metadata.purpose: Verify the MEL tangent-command repair that bypasses the broken maya.cmds.keyTangent wrapper.
acceptance: Fast-forward AIMayaTool main and include commit 4e30ab31798c32e58800bbd8d5808db67c67d7ff or later.
Compile weight_profile.py, weight_profile_smoke.py, and focused tests.
Import aimayatool.tools.skinning.weight_profile outside Maya without requiring maya.cmds or maya.mel at import time.
Run tests.test_skinning_weight_profile and require all focused tests to pass, including MEL tangent command and unsupported-tangent coverage.
metadata.evidence: py_compile passed for weight_profile.py, weight_profile_smoke.py, and focused tests; non-Maya import passed; tests.test_skinning_weight_profile passed 5/5 including MEL tangent command and unsupported-tangent coverage.

metadata.purpose: Retry managed Maya weight-profile validation using MEL tangent commands instead of the broken Python keyTangent wrapper.
acceptance: Reuse a healthy managed Maya session where possible.
Force a fresh unsaved scene and do not save or quit Maya.
Run the current weight-profile smoke from disk after syncing commit 4e30ab31798c32e58800bbd8d5808db67c67d7ff or later.
Return AIBRIDGE_UI_SMOKE_OK:SKINNING_WEIGHT_PROFILE_SMOKE_OK.
metadata.evidence: Managed Maya 2024 still raised Invalid flag 'outgoingTangentType' while _set_tangent executed the MEL keyTangent command path. This proves the command parser/alias path is affected too. Product repair now avoids keyTangent commands entirely and sets endpoint tangent types through maya.api.OpenMayaAnim.MFnAnimCurve.

metadata.evidence: Managed Maya reused the existing session and returned an outgoingTangentType error even though current main weight_profile.py contains no keyTangent command path. The traceback line mapping also mismatched current source. This is stale imported-module/runtime evidence, so the smoke now reloads weight_profile from disk before validation.
